title: Pure-tensor normalized comparison of ordinary slice restriction and total tensor
statement: Let J be a Grothendieck topology on a category C with object universe c and morphism universe v. Let A be a commutative ring sheaf with values in max(c,v,u), with module sheafification and locally bijective sheafification equivalences, and let U be an object of C. Write R for termwise exact slice restriction [def-sfb-ringed-slice-comparison-model] and Tot for coefficientTotalTensor [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model]. There is a natural chain isomorphism gamma: Tot followed by R isomorphic to (R product R) followed by the slice Tot. For arbitrary complexes P,Q, integers p,q,k with p+q=k, an object V over U and sections x of P^p and y of Q^q over V.left, gamma in degree k over V takes coefficientTensorGenerator(P,Q,p,q,k,x,y) to coefficientTensorGenerator(RP,RQ,p,q,k,x,y). No K-flatness, flat terms, derived category or boundedness is assumed.

proof.text: Conjugate the canonical site tensor restriction comparison with the proved native-to-site tensor isomorphisms. Their pure-section formulas imply that the inverse comparison sends x tensor y to x tensor y; pure sections detect equality and prove naturality in both arguments.

source.place: Modules on Sites Tag 03EL; the native and site sheafified tensor presentations.

proof.text: Restriction of abelian sheaves to the slice is also a left adjoint and preserves coproducts. Reflect colimit preservation through the module forgetful functor using its colimit and reflection APIs. Assemble the native module tensor comparisons as a curried natural transformation. Apply HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorComparison, its invertibility instance, and its naturality theorem to obtain a natural isomorphism of total tensor complexes. Its coprojection equation, evaluated on each actual sheafified pure section, proves precisely the coefficientTensorGenerator formula. The construction uses the same unbounded coproducts for zero or arbitrary unbounded complexes.

theorem ringedSlice_totalTensorComparison_exists (U : C) :
    ∃ γ : coefficientTotalTensor.{u, c, v} J A ⋙
        ringedSliceComplexRestriction.{c, v, u} J A U ≅
      ((ringedSliceComplexRestriction.{c, v, u} J A U).prod
        (ringedSliceComplexRestriction.{c, v, u} J A U)) ⋙
          coefficientTotalTensor.{u, max c v, v} (J.over U) (A.over U),
      ∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{max c v u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂
        CommRingCat.{max c v u} RingCat.{max c v u})).obj A)) ℤ)
        (p q k : ℤ) (h : p + q = k) (V : Over U)
        (x : (P.X p).val.obj (op V.left)) (y : (Q.X q).val.obj (op V.left)),
        ((γ.hom.app (P, Q)).f k).val.app (op V)
          (coefficientTensorGenerator.{u, c, v} J A P Q p q k h (op V.left) x y) =
        coefficientTensorGenerator.{u, max c v, v} (J.over U) (A.over U)
          ((ringedSliceComplexRestriction.{c, v, u} J A U).obj P)
          ((ringedSliceComplexRestriction.{c, v, u} J A U).obj Q) p q k h (op V) x y
